title: Jimmy Carter's UFO briefing confirmed by Alonzo McDonald
place_text: Oval Office, White House, Washington DC

tellings.quote: but I know that Alonzo McDonald confirmed to several of us that um and our group during that era, the OAP era, that uh he talked to the staff that attended that briefing. He talked to Carter and it happened.

plain: President Jimmy Carter is said to have been given a briefing on UFOs in the Oval Office in 1977, and a man named Alonzo McDonald is said to have confirmed it. The physicist Eric W. Davis, who has worked as a scientist for the Pentagon, tells Michels he did not see this himself: McDonald told Davis's research group back then that he had spoken with the staff who attended the briefing, and with Carter, and "it happened." Davis also points to a Carter Library list of attendees dated June 1977. If true, a sitting president was formally told about UFOs.
